summary: Stage 3 Phase 2 backend testing complete: Crash Events and Roadside Assistance modules fully functional. All 94 tests passed (100% success rate). New features: (1) Crash Events with POST/GET/PUT endpoints, auto-creates critical alerts when confirmed=true, driver-scoped access. (2) Roadside Assistance with 6 seeded providers, auto-selects fastest provider by ETA, full dispatch lifecycle (requested → confirmed → en_route → arrived → completed/cancelled), driver-scoped access. (3) Co-Pilot dispatch_roadside action integrated. All 64 regression tests from iteration 5 passed.

minor_observations.observation: LLM did not emit action marker when driver said 'I blew a tire' because it detected a duplicate request from earlier in the test session. LLM replied: 'Hold up, Diego — looks like we already sent roadside for that tire.' This is CORRECT context-aware behavior, not a bug.
minor_observations.impact: None - this demonstrates the LLM is working correctly and being context-aware

minor_observations.observation: LLM did not emit action marker when driver was in sleeper berth status. LLM correctly asked if driver wants to switch to driving first. This is CORRECT safety-aware behavior.
minor_observations.impact: None - this is correct LLM behavior

minor_observations.observation: LLM did not emit action marker when trip status was 'planned' not 'active'. LLM correctly noted the trip hasn't started yet. This is CORRECT context-aware behavior.
minor_observations.impact: None - this is correct LLM behavior
